subcategory_text: Adequate resource capacity to ensure availability is maintained
informative_references: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5: CP-06, CP-07, CP-08, PM-03, PM-09
CRI Profile v2.0: PR.IR-04, PR.IR-04.01, PR.IR-04.02
implementation_examples: Monitor usage of storage, power, compute, network bandwidth, and other resources
Forecast future needs, and scale resources accordingly
assessment_objectives: Determine whether adequate resource capacity to ensure availability is maintained.
Determine whether activities are conducted to monitor usage of storage, power, compute, network bandwidth, and other resources.
Determine whether mechanisms ensure that forecast future needs, and scale resources accordingly.
Determine whether implementation outcomes are monitored, evaluated, and documented.
